headline: Ledger probes reported wallet drains tied to a reseller

scenes.vo: Ledger is investigating reports that buyers from one of its resellers lost crypto. Blockchain sleuths estimate more than eighty-six million dollars. Here's what changed.
The reports involve CryptoBilis, an official reseller in Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippines. Ledger told it to pause all sales and shipments while it investigates.
The catch. Ledger has not confirmed the amount or the cause. There is no confirmed sign its own systems were hacked. One theory is tampered devices sold through that reseller.
Bought from that reseller in the last ninety days? Ledger says don't set it up. If you already did, move funds to a new device with a new recovery phrase. Watch for Ledger's findings.
